comments.text: the course, 176 rows of 65 characters, $41 bytes a row ($8952, $8A02 give each row's address), drawn 21 rows at a time and 65 columns round. Seven sections of 25 rows start at rows 0 (the start), 25, 50, 75, 100, 125 and 150 (the finish, with the banner across rows 156 and 159); $C543 says in which order a run takes them. The snow inside the course is character 0, the flags $88, $26 and $28 placed by $C42D
